# Supabase Connector for Muse

⚠️ Security warning: this connector requires your Supabase service_role API key. This key bypasses ALL Row Level Security policies on your database. Keep it private and use at your own risk.
Curated by Skill Harbor — a free, open-source build (MIT) by @bluman1, listed here with credit to its creator. A Muse agent skill that reads and writes your Supabase Postgres database over PostgREST: list tables, query rows, and insert/update/delete rows. Writes need exact-match confirmation on every call, and updates/deletes refuse to run without an equality filter — table-wide writes are never allowed. Note: it uses the service_role key, which bypasses Row Level Security. No secrets in the repo — credentials stay in Muse's secure vault.
